        return
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    B = [0] * 101
    value = M
    carry = 0
    for i in range(100):

        carry = 0

            carry = 1
        B[i] = digit
        value //= W
    B[100] += carry
    for i in range(101):
        if B[i] < -1 or B[i] > 1:
            print("NO")
            return
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
